blocks.text: Savol ichidagi savol: Do you know where ...?

Savol boshqa gap ichiga kirsa (Do you know ...? I don't know ... He asked me ...), u **bilvosita savol** (indirect question) bo'ladi va **darak gap tartibini** oladi: Where **is** the station? → Do you know where the station **is**? Yordamchi fe'l oldinga chiqmaydi, **do / does / did yo'qoladi**: What time **does** the film start? → Could you tell me what time the film **starts**? Asoslar qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 49-dars), oddiy savol tartibi — 49-darsda.

Qizig'i, o'zbek tilida ham xuddi shunday hodisa bor: savol gap ichiga kirganda u so'roq shaklini yo'qotadi. «U qayerda?» → «U qayerda **ekanini** bilasizmi?», «Qachon keladi?» → «Qachon **kelishini** bilmayman». O'zbekchada «-mi» o'rniga «ekanini», «-ganini», «-ishini» keladi, inglizchada esa so'roq tartibi o'rniga **darak tartibi**.

rows: Do you know where the station **is**?
Could you tell me what time the film **starts**?
Do you know who **lives** here? (tartib o'zgarmaydi)

items.text: Can you remember **who told** you that?

blocks.text: Notanish odamga, xizmat ko'rsatish joyida yoki rasmiy vaziyatda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol keskin eshitilishi mumkin. Bilvosita savol ancha **muloyim**: **Could you tell me** ...? **Do you happen to know** ...? **Would you mind telling me** ...? **I was wondering if** ... Tinish belgisiga e'tibor bering: gapning o'zi savol bo'lsa — **?** (Do you know where it is?), darak bo'lsa — **nuqta** (I wonder where it is.).

items.text: Could you tell me **where** the toilets **are**, please?
I was wondering **if** you **were** free on Friday evening.
items.translation: Juma kuni kechqurun **bo'sh emasmisiz**, deb o'ylab turgandim.

items.text: Would you mind telling me **how much** this **costs**?

blocks.text: if / whether — ha / yo'q savoli ichkarida

So'roq so'zi bo'lmasa (ha / yo'q savoli), **if** yoki **whether** qo'shiladi: Is she at home? → I don't know **if** she **is** at home. O'zbekchada bunga «**-mi, -yo'qmi**», «**bor-yo'qligini**» to'g'ri keladi: «Uyda**mi-yo'qmi**, bilmayman». **whether** biroz rasmiyroq va ba'zi joylarda yagona variant: **whether or not**, predlogdan keyin (It depends on **whether** ...) va infinitivdan oldin (I can't decide **whether to** go).
O'zlashtirma savol: He asked me where I lived

Birovning savolini yetkazganda ham xuddi shu qoida ishlaydi: **asked (me)**, **wanted to know**, **wondered** + so'roq so'zi yoki if / whether + **darak tartibi**. «aytish» fe'li o'tgan zamonda bo'lgani uchun zamon bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi (→ 47-dars). Oxirida so'roq belgisi qo'yilmaydi: She asked me where I **lived**. («She asked me where did I live?» ✗).

rows: She wanted to know **whether** I **could** swim.

items.text: The manager asked me **where** I **had worked** before.
An old man asked **if** I **was** a student.
They wanted to know **what** I **thought** of the plan.
items.translation: Ular reja haqida **nima deb o'ylashimni bilishmoqchi bo'ldi**.

blocks.text: **think, suppose, reckon, believe, imagine** bilan fikr so'raganda so'roq so'zi **boshida** qoladi, **do you think** o'rtaga kiradi, qolgani darak tartibida: Where **do you think** he **is**? — Sizningcha, u qayerda? «Do you think where he is?» — xato. Ha / yo'q savolida esa do you think boshida: **Do you think** he**'s** right? O'zbekchadagi «**Sizningcha**, ...?» ga aynan mos keladi.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Do you know where is the bank?» → Do you know where the bank **is**?; «Can you tell me what time does it open?» → what time it **opens**; «I don't know does he like it» → I don't know **if** he likes it; «She asked me where did I live» → She asked me where I **lived**; «He asked me am I busy» → He asked me **if I was** busy; «Do you think where he went?» → Where **do you think** he went?

Qoida bitta: savol **boshqa gapning ichiga** kirdimi — u endi savol emas, demak, darak tartibi (ega + fe'l) va do / does / did yo'q. O'zbekcha tarjimada «**ekanini**», «**-ganini**», «**-mi, -yo'qmi**» ni ko'rsangiz — inglizchada bilvosita savol kerak.

rows: I don't know what time it **starts**.
Xushmuomala: Could you tell me ...? I was wondering if ...
Could you tell me how I **get** there?
O'zlashtirma savol: asked + darak tartibi + backshift
Fikr so'rash: so'roq so'zi + do you think + darak tartibi

examples.title: **Do you know where** ... **is**? — statement order
examples.description: Savol boshqa gap ichida: yordamchi fe'l egadan keyin qoladi. O'zbekchada «qayerda ekanini», «nima qilayotganini».

sentences.text: Do you know **where** the nearest pharmacy **is**? My son has a fever.
sentences.translation: Eng yaqin dorixona **qayerda ekanini** bilasizmi? O'g'limning isitmasi bor.

sentences.text: I have no idea **what** Aziz **is doing** these days — he never answers his phone.
sentences.translation: Aziz shu kunlarda **nima qilayotganini** umuman bilmayman — telefonini hech ko'tarmaydi.

sentences.text: Can you remember **where** we**'ve parked** the car? We've been walking around for ages.
sentences.translation: Mashinani **qayerga qo'yganimizni** eslay olasanmi? Ancha vaqtdan beri aylanib yuribmiz.

sentences.text: Nobody knows **how long** the repairs **will take**.
sentences.translation: Ta'mirlash **qancha vaqt olishini** hech kim bilmaydi.

sentences.text: Any idea **who** that woman with Madina **is**?
sentences.translation: Madina bilan turgan o'sha ayol **kimligini** bilmaysizmi?

sentences.text: I'm not sure **which platform** the Samarkand train **is leaving** from.
sentences.translation: Samarqand poyezdi **qaysi platformadan jo'nashini** aniq bilmayman.

sentences.text: Tell me **what** you**'re** really **thinking** — I won't be angry.
sentences.translation: Aslida **nima deb o'ylayotganingni** ayt — jahlim chiqmaydi.

sentences.text: We still don't know **when** the results **will be published**.
sentences.translation: Natijalar **qachon e'lon qilinishini** hali ham bilmaymiz.

sentences.text: Has anyone found out **why** the lift **isn't working** again?
sentences.translation: Lift nega yana **ishlamayotganini** kimdir aniqladimi?

sentences.text: Do you know **who has taken** my charger? It was on my desk a minute ago.
sentences.translation: Zaryadlovchimni **kim olganini** bilasizmi? Bir daqiqa oldin stolimda edi.

examples.title: No **do** / **did**: what time the film **starts**
examples.description: Present va Past Simple dagi savol gap ichiga kirganda do / does / did yo'qoladi, fe'l odatdagi shaklini oladi: starts, left, costs.

sentences.text: Could you tell me **what time** the museum **opens** on Sundays?
sentences.translation: Muzey yakshanba kunlari **soat nechada ochilishini** ayta olasizmi?

sentences.text: I don't understand **why** Jasur **left** his job — he loved it.
sentences.translation: Jasur nega ishdan **ketganini** tushunmayapman — u ishini yaxshi ko'rardi.

sentences.text: Do you know **how much** a ticket to London **costs** at the moment?
sentences.translation: Hozir Londonga chipta **qancha turishini** bilasizmi?

sentences.text: I'd love to know **where** Emma **bought** that beautiful dress.
sentences.translation: Emma o'sha chiroyli ko'ylakni **qayerdan olganini** juda bilgim keladi.

sentences.text: Nobody remembers **what** the teacher **said** about the homework.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi uy vazifasi haqida **nima deganini** hech kim eslamaydi.

sentences.text: Ask Bekzod **how** he **gets** to work so quickly every morning.
sentences.translation: Bekzoddan har kuni ertalab ishga qanday qilib tez **yetib kelishini** so'rang.

sentences.text: It's not clear **when** exactly the accident **happened**.
sentences.translation: Avariya aynan **qachon sodir bo'lgani** aniq emas.

sentences.text: Have you any idea **what** this word **means**? It's not in my dictionary.
sentences.translation: Bu so'z **nimani anglatishini** bilmaysizmi? Lug'atimda yo'q.

sentences.text: Do you remember **which hotel** we **stayed** at in Edinburgh?
sentences.translation: Edinburgda qaysi mehmonxonada **qolganimizni** eslaysizmi?

sentences.text: I wonder **how** Oliver **manages** to work full-time and study at the same time.
sentences.translation: Oliver qanday qilib bir vaqtda to'liq ishlab, o'qishga ham **ulgurishiga** hayronman.

examples.title: Polite: **Could you tell me** ...? **I was wondering if** ...
examples.description: Bilvosita savol to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savoldan muloyimroq: notanish odam, xizmat ko'rsatish, rasmiy vaziyat.

sentences.text: **Could you tell me where** the conference room **is**, please?
sentences.translation: Konferensiya zali **qayerdaligini** ayta olasizmi?

sentences.text: **Would you mind telling me** how old this building **is**?
sentences.translation: Bu bino **necha yillik ekanini** aytib bera olmaysizmi?

sentences.text: **I was wondering if** you **could** help me with my CV.
sentences.translation: Rezyumemga **yordam bera olmasmikansiz**, deb o'ylab turgandim.

sentences.text: **Do you happen to know** what time the bank **closes** on Saturdays?
sentences.translation: Bank shanba kunlari **soat nechada yopilishini** bilmaysizmi?

sentences.text: **Can you tell me** how I **get** to the Registan from here?
sentences.translation: Bu yerdan Registonga **qanday borishimni** ayta olasizmi?

sentences.text: Excuse me, **I'd like to know** whether this train **stops** at Jizzakh.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu poyezd Jizzaxda **to'xtaydimi-yo'qmi**, bilmoqchi edim.

sentences.text: **May I ask** why you **are leaving** the company?
sentences.translation: Kompaniyadan nega **ketayotganingizni** so'rasam maylimi?

sentences.text: **Could you let me know** when the documents **are** ready?
sentences.translation: Hujjatlar **qachon tayyor bo'lishini** menga xabar qila olasizmi?

sentences.text: **Have you got any idea** how long the delay **will be**?
sentences.translation: Kechikish **qancha davom etishini** bilmaysizmi?

sentences.text: **I'm afraid I don't know** where Mr Brown **has gone**, but he'll be back soon.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, janob Braun **qayerga ketganini** bilmayman, lekin u tez orada qaytadi.

examples.title: **if** / **whether**: yes / no questions inside
examples.description: So'roq so'zi bo'lmasa — if yoki whether. whether or not, whether to + fe'l, predlogdan keyin — faqat whether. O'zbekchada «-mi, -yo'qmi».

sentences.text: I'm not sure **if** the shops **are** open on New Year's Day.
sentences.translation: Yangi yil kuni do'konlar **ochiq bo'ladimi-yo'qmi**, aniq bilmayman.

sentences.text: Ask Madina **whether** she**'d** like to join us for lunch.
sentences.translation: Madinadan biz bilan tushlikka **qo'shilishni xohlaydimi-yo'qmi**, so'rang.

sentences.text: I can't remember **if** I **locked** the front door this morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab old eshikni **qulflaganim-qulflamaganimni** eslay olmayapman.

sentences.text: We're still deciding **whether to** fly or take the train to Khiva.
sentences.translation: Xivaga samolyotda **uchsakmi** yoki poyezdda **borsakmi**, hali qaror qilyapmiz.

sentences.text: Nobody could tell me **whether or not** the flight **had been** cancelled.
sentences.translation: Reys **bekor qilinganmi-yo'qmi**, hech kim ayta olmadi.

sentences.text: Let me check **if** there **are** any seats left for tonight's show.
sentences.translation: Bugungi kechki tomoshaga **joy qolganmi**, tekshirib ko'ray.

sentences.text: It depends on **whether** the weather **is** good enough for a picnic.
sentences.translation: Bu ob-havo piknik uchun **yetarlicha yaxshi bo'lishiga** bog'liq.

sentences.text: I doubt **whether** Tom **will** finish the project on time.
sentences.translation: Tom loyihani o'z vaqtida **tugatishiga** shubha qilaman.

sentences.text: Have you heard **if** Kate **got** the job in Manchester?
sentences.translation: Keyt Manchesterdagi ishga **olindimi**, eshitmadingizmi?

sentences.text: The doctor wants to know **whether** you**'re** allergic to any medicines.
sentences.translation: Shifokor sizda biror dorga **allergiya bor-yo'qligini** bilmoqchi.

examples.title: Reported questions: **asked me where I lived**
examples.description: Birovning savolini yetkazish: asked / wanted to know / wondered + so'roq so'zi + darak tartibi + backshift. So'roq belgisi yo'q.

sentences.text: The police officer **asked** us **where we were going** at that time of night.
sentences.translation: Politsiyachi kechaning o'sha paytida **qayerga ketayotganimizni so'radi**.

sentences.text: My grandmother always **asks** me **when** I**'m** going to get married.
sentences.translation: Buvim doim **qachon uylanishimni so'raydi**.

sentences.text: At the interview they **asked** me **why** I **wanted** to work for their company.
sentences.translation: Suhbatda ularning kompaniyasida nega **ishlamoqchi ekanimni so'rashdi**.

sentences.text: Kate **wanted to know how much** I **had paid** for my new phone.
sentences.translation: Keyt yangi telefonimga **qancha to'laganimni bilmoqchi bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: A tourist **asked** me **which bus went** to the Chorsu Bazaar.
sentences.translation: Bir sayyoh Chorsu bozoriga **qaysi avtobus borishini so'radi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **asked** his teacher **what** the word «reliable» **meant**.
sentences.translation: Jasur o'qituvchisidan «reliable» so'zi **nimani anglatishini so'radi**.

sentences.text: I **wondered why** nobody **had told** me about the change of plan.
sentences.translation: Reja o'zgargani haqida nega hech kim menga **aytmaganiga hayron bo'ldim**.

sentences.text: Oliver's parents **asked** him **who he had been** with all night.
sentences.translation: Oliverning ota-onasi undan tun bo'yi **kim bilan bo'lganini so'rashdi**.

sentences.text: The receptionist **asked** us **how long** we **were planning** to stay.
sentences.translation: Qabulxona xodimi necha kun **qolishni rejalashtirganimizni so'radi**.

sentences.text: When I called the bank, they **asked** me **what** my date of birth **was**.
sentences.translation: Bankka qo'ng'iroq qilganimda, mendan **tug'ilgan sanamni so'rashdi**.

examples.title: Reported yes / no: **asked if** ..., **wanted to know whether**
examples.description: Ha / yo'q savolini yetkazish: asked (me) if / whether + darak tartibi + backshift. O'zbekchada «... -mi, deb so'radi».

sentences.text: The waiter **asked** us **if** we **were** ready to order.
sentences.translation: Ofitsiant buyurtma berishga **tayyormisizlar, deb so'radi**.

sentences.text: Madina **asked** me **whether** I **had** ever **been** to Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Madina mendan Edinburgda hech **bo'lganmisan, deb so'radi**.

sentences.text: My boss **wanted to know if** I **could** work on Saturday.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'im shanba kuni **ishlay olamanmi-yo'qmi, bilmoqchi bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: At passport control, the officer **asked** me **if** I **was** travelling alone.
sentences.translation: Pasport nazoratida xodim **yolg'iz sayohat qilyapsizmi, deb so'radi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **asked** his friends **whether** they **would** help him move house.
sentences.translation: Bekzod do'stlaridan uy ko'chishda **yordam berishadimi-yo'qmi, so'radi**.

sentences.text: I **wondered if** I **had made** the right decision.
sentences.translation: To'g'ri qaror **qildimmikan, deb o'yladim**.

sentences.text: Sarah **asked** me **if** I **knew** a good dentist near the university.
sentences.translation: Sara universitet yaqinida yaxshi tish shifokorini **bilamanmi, deb so'radi**.

sentences.text: They **asked** us **whether** we **wanted** a room with a view or a quieter one.
sentences.translation: Ular bizdan manzarali xona **xohlaymizmi** yoki tinchrog'ini, **deb so'rashdi**.

sentences.text: James **asked whether** he **could** borrow my car for the weekend.
sentences.translation: Jeyms dam olish kunlariga mashinamni **olib tursa bo'ladimi, deb so'radi**.

sentences.text: When I came home late, Dad **asked** me **if** I **had** forgotten what time it was.
sentences.translation: Kech qaytganimda, dadam soat necha bo'lganini **unutib qo'ydingmi, deb so'radi**.

examples.title: **Where do you think** ...? Asking for opinions
examples.description: Fikr so'rash: so'roq so'zi + do you think / suppose / reckon + darak tartibi. Ha / yo'q savolida — Do you think ...? boshida.

sentences.text: Where **do you think** Aziz **has gone**? His car isn't outside.
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, Aziz **qayerga ketgan**? Mashinasi tashqarida yo'q.

sentences.text: How much **do you think** this flat **is** worth?
sentences.translation: Nima deb o'ylaysiz, bu kvartira **qancha turadi**?

sentences.text: Who **do you think will win** the World Cup this time?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, bu safar jahon chempionatida **kim g'olib bo'ladi**?

sentences.text: What **do you suppose happened** to the old cinema? It's been closed for months.
sentences.translation: Eski kinoteatrga **nima bo'lgan** deb o'ylaysiz? Oylardan beri yopiq.

sentences.text: **Do you think** Jasur **is** right about the new manager?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, Jasur yangi menejer haqida **haqmi**?

sentences.text: Why **do you think** Kate **didn't come** to the party?
sentences.translation: Nima deb o'ylaysiz, Keyt nega ziyofatga **kelmadi**?

sentences.text: When **do you reckon** the new metro line **will open**?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, yangi metro liniyasi **qachon ochiladi**?

sentences.text: Which of these two jackets **do you think suits** me better?
sentences.translation: Sizga qanday tuyuladi, bu ikki kurtkaning qaysi biri menga **ko'proq yarashadi**?

sentences.text: How long **do you imagine** it **would take** to walk from here to Chorsu?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, bu yerdan Chorsugacha piyoda borish **qancha vaqt oladi**?

sentences.text: What time **do you think** we **should** leave to catch the eight o'clock train?
sentences.translation: Soat sakkizdagi poyezdga ulgurish uchun soat nechada **chiqishimiz kerak**, sizningcha?

examples.title: Dialogue: what did they ask at the interview?
examples.description: Do'st ish suhbatidan keyin nimalar so'ralganini aytib beradi: asked me why, wanted to know if, I wonder if, when do you think.

sentences.text: — So, how did the interview go? What **did** they **ask** you?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, suhbat qanday o'tdi? Sendan nimalar **so'rashdi**?

sentences.text: — First they **asked** me **why** I **wanted** to leave my current job.
sentences.translation: — Avval hozirgi ishimdan nega **ketmoqchi ekanimni so'rashdi**.

sentences.text: — That's a tricky one. Did they **ask** you **how much** you **earn** now?
sentences.translation: — Qiyin savol ekan. Hozir **qancha topishingni** ham **so'rashdimi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, and they **wanted to know if** I **could** start next month.
sentences.translation: — Ha, kelasi oydan **boshlay olamanmi-yo'qmi, bilishmoqchi bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: — Could you? I'm not sure **whether** your boss **will** let you go so quickly.
sentences.translation: — Boshlay olasanmi? Boshlig'ing seni tez **qo'yib yuboradimi-yo'qmi**, bilmayman.

sentences.text: — Me neither. Then they **asked** me **what** my biggest weakness **was**.
sentences.translation: — Men ham bilmayman. Keyin eng katta kamchiligim **nima ekanini so'rashdi**.

sentences.text: — Oh no! **Do you remember what** you **said**?
sentences.translation: — Voy! **Nima deganingni eslaysanmi**?

sentences.text: — I said I sometimes worked too hard. I **wonder if** they **believed** me!
sentences.translation: — Ba'zan haddan tashqari ko'p ishlayman, dedim. **Ishonishdimikan**, bilmadim!

sentences.text: — Ha! And **when do you think** they**'ll** let you know?
sentences.translation: — Ha-ha! Sening fikringcha, ular **qachon xabar berishadi**?

sentences.text: — They didn't say, but I **asked** them **if** they **could** reply by Friday.
sentences.translation: — Aytishmadi, lekin juma kunigacha **javob bera olasizlarmi, deb so'radim**.
